mapper.select: SELECT SCHEDULE_ID FROM MTG_SCHEDULE ORDER BY SCHEDULE_ID DESC LIMIT 1;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MTG_SCHEDULE ( SCHEDULE_ID, STAFF_ID, SUB_STAFF_ID, CLIENT_NAME, CLIENT_COMP_NAME, MTG_ID, ROOM_ID, MTG_PLACE, SCHEDULED_DATE, SCHEDULED_TIME, COMMENT, CREATED_DATE, CREATED_USER ) VALUES ( #{scheduleId}, #{userId}, #{subUserId}, #{clientName}, #{clientCompName}, #{mtgId}, #{roomId}, #{mtgPlace}, #{scheduledDate}, #{scheduledTime}, #{comment}, #{createdDate}, #{createdUserId} );
